           POLYPORUS PINICOLA

         Pine Agaric


Useful in intermittent, remittent and bilious fevers, with headache,
        yellow tongue, constant nausea, faintness at epigastrium, and constipation. Similar to its
        botanical relative,   Polyp officinalis  , or   Boletus laricis, q.v  . Deep dull, severe pain in shin bones,
        preventing sleep.



Fever.--  Great lassitude, congestion of head, with vertigo,
        face hot and flushed, prickling sensation all over; restless at night from pain in wrists
        and knee; rheumatic pains; profuse perspiration. Headache about 10 am, with pain in back,
        ankles and legs increasing until 3 pm, then gradually better.
